budget: 36/360; largest-remainder by known day batch sizes of 204 and 156. Ties for fractional slots go to earlier day.
diagnostics: Daywise scores exactly tied at the cutoff and tie-neutral expected hits/range; model score rounding to 12 decimals only as numerical sensitivity. Held-out experiment blocks are not independent parts. No test hypotheses or confidence intervals with 2 days.
information_known_before_scoring: Dates, day sizes, outcome totals, materials, label clustering, a descriptive summary of feature distribution shifts, and availability of 8 chosen sensors were known. The protocol was fixed before fitting/evaluating models on this dataset. Private analysis record, not external registration.
model_comparison: Full RBF gamma=0.25*scale, PCA4 RBF gamma=scale; two-layer H/RZ quantum fidelity kernel with and without linear-neighbor RZZ; phase multiplier 0.5 / train-PC RMS
model_fit: Fit once, first day only; no refitting before test day 2; median imputation, nonconstant filter, StandardScaler; PCA(n_components=4, svd_solver=full) fit in training; SVC balanced C=1
primary: Using fixed daily slots, additional detected defective parts of Q4 + RZZ versus PCA4 RBF; totals and per-day counts, proportion of all defects detected. No score tuning.
ranking: descending unrounded decision function, break exact ties by cycle time then unique MachineCycleID
secondary: Pooled top 36; Q4 - no RZZ; full-RBF; number of distinct defective (day,setting) blocks found; average precision. Matched detected sets and expected hits for uniform random inspection at each quota.
unit: one part/cycle; group for block reporting = date + MET_ExperimentNumber
